messages:
Maya: Pushed q6b-int4 to staging for a quick smoke. Latency looks fine but we see a small quality drop on promptset A (longform summarization). Thinking we should do a golden refresh + dedupe sweep before wider rollout. :eyes:
Sam: Can you drop a failing example and the metric diffs? Want to know if this is prompt sensitivity or quant noise.
Maya: Example (trimmed):
```input
Article: ... <long article> ...
Expected: TL;DR focusing on outcomes
Model(q5): Concise summary hitting outcomes
Model(q6b-int4): Adds extra invented entities, misses a couple core bullets
```
Devin: Ran a batch eval this morning. Deltas vs q5 baseline: ROUGE-L -2.3, ROUGE-1 -1.1, hallucination score +0.08. Failure cluster is mostly for inputs >512 tokens. Looks like KV-cache truncation interactions with new int4 kernel tiling.
Sam: Any tokenizer changes in this bring-up? That would explain shifts.
Maya: No tokenizer changes. The runtime switched an attention tiling path for int4 to improve throughput. I'll repro locally and attach logs.
Maya: Quick repro command: ```bash
./run_eval.sh --model q6b-int4 --prompts promptsetA --out diffs.json\```
Rachel: @Rachel from labeling ops — we can prioritize a 200-sample relabel of the golden set if you surface the list and priority tags.
Maya: Posting a gist with the sample ids + initial diffs: https://gist.github.com/xxxx/samplelist
label-bot: Created LabelFlow task LR-482 for "q6b-int4 golden relabel" with 200 items, priority: high, ETA 48h. :robot_face:
Devin: Suggestion: run a targeted quant ablation matrix (int4 w/ alternate kernel flag, int8 baseline, and int4 w/ slow attention path) on same hardware. If regression goes away with alternate kernel, we isolate to kernel change.
Sam: Proposed plan: 1) kick off quick golden relabel 200 (Rachel), 2) run ablation (Devin), 3) if relabeled gold still shows regression, fallback routing: route >512-token requests to q5 canary while we triage.
Rachel: I'll stand up the relabel quickly and set QA threshold to 95% pass for the sample batch. Will ping labelers. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Canary deploy q6b-int4 -> staging completed at 1768512488.
Maya: Thanks. I'll gather diffs from the relabel and ablation and post results here. If labels confirm model drift, we'll open a runtime kernel rollback ticket.
Sam: Good plan — please @channel when you have the relabel summary. :raised_hands:
